scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "python3 -m backend.main" "cd frontend && npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173"
scripts.install:all: python3 -m pip install -r ./backend/requirements.txt && npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && python -m compileall backend
scripts.dev:all: npm run install:all && npm run dev
